promptAsSent:
Use the image_gen tool to generate exactly one image, then stop. Do not write files, run commands or edit anything.

Attached reference images, in order:
Image 1: Image 1: silhouette, proportion and registration authority; keep outline, refine detail
Image 2: Image 2: material language only; do not copy its wide body

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-source concept for one modular top-down tactical-game mech ARM weapon sprite.
Primary request: the HC-10, a light single-shot armour-piercing cannon: the smaller sibling of the heavy cannon in Image 2. One straight, thick single-bore gun barrel with a short slotted muzzle brake at its tip, a reinforced barrel collar, and a compact narrow breech/receiver block with twin short recoil buffers along its flanks and a small rear mounting tab. Same manufacturer and material language as Image 2, but clearly slimmer and shorter: it must fit on a mech's side arm beside the chassis, and also turn on a tank's turret ring, so the barrel runs exactly down the vertical centre line of the module.
Image 1 is the silhouette, proportion and registration authority: keep its overall outline, width and length, with the barrel on the centre column; refine the detail inside it. Image 2 is material language only (olive-drab painted casing, dark gunmetal barrel, amber service lamps, fasteners, panel seams); do not copy its wide body.
Critical perspective: strict 90-degree zenith orthographic top-down view. The camera looks straight down at the TOP surfaces of the weapon. The weapon fires horizontally toward the NORTH/TOP edge of the canvas, parallel to the battlefield plane. The muzzle faces AWAY from the camera, so no circular bore or aperture face is visible; at the extreme north tip show only a thin edge-on dark muzzle lip.
Style/medium: crisp high-resolution painted game sprite matching the existing modular mech weapon family: fine surface noise, panel seams, fasteners, restrained wear, upper-left baked object lighting, neutral olive-drab painted composite casing, dark gunmetal barrel and mechanisms, small amber service lamps.
Composition/framing: exactly one isolated vertical module centred with generous padding on a flat featureless pure white isolation plate (no gradient, shadow, halo, floor, border or checkerboard). Bilaterally symmetrical so it mirrors to either arm.
Avoid: multiple barrels, rotary cluster, rails or coils (it is not a gauss or linear gun), visible circular muzzle, upward-pointing barrel, perspective, isometric, side view, multiple objects, hands, mech body, vehicle, turret base, text, logo, watermark, cropping.

agentMessages: I’ll generate one HC-10 concept using Image 1’s proportions and Image 2’s materials.
